title: MCHDoc：多载体中国历史文献阅读综合基准
titleEn: MCHDoc: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multi-Carrier Chinese Historical Document Reading
thumbnailAlt: MCHDoc 多载体历史文献阅读流程
description: 覆盖六类历史载体的 15,724 张高分辨率文献图像，支持页面识别、字符识别与后校正评测。
descriptionEn: A collection of 15,724 high-resolution images across six historical media, supporting page recognition, character recognition, and post-correction evaluation.

title: EpiAgent：面向古代碑刻修复的智能体系统
titleEn: EpiAgent: An Agentic System for Ancient Inscription Restoration
thumbnailAlt: EpiAgent 古代碑刻修复效果对比
description: 通过多模态感知、经验引导规划、专用修复工具与自我反思协同完成残损古籍修复。
descriptionEn: Coordinates multimodal perception, experience-guided planning, specialized restoration tools, and self-reflection to restore damaged historical documents.

title: CIRI：碑刻修复基准数据集
titleEn: CIRI: A Benchmark Dataset for Inscription Restoration
thumbnailAlt: CIRI 残损古籍修复对比结果
description: 面向中国碑拓图像修复的基准，结合真实残损拓片、合成配对数据与全局-局部扩散修复基线。
descriptionEn: A benchmark for restoring Chinese inscription rubbings, combining authentic damaged rubbings, synthetic paired data, and a global-local diffusion baseline.

title: Resolving Inherited Ambiguity in Chinese Historical Phonology with Song Dynasty Corpus Evidence
thumbnailAlt: QYSPD 论文图 6：扩展反切主路径
description: Haiyue Liu, Hui Xue*, Na Nie, Shipeng Zhu. 结合《广韵》内部证据与宋代多体裁语境，推断多音反切字的主反切并构建主路径。
descriptionEn: Haiyue Liu, Hui Xue*, Na Nie, Shipeng Zhu. Infers primary readings for polyphonic fanqie spellers and constructs primary paths from Guangyun evidence and multi-genre Song-dynasty contexts.
